lede: The biggest item this week is Tuesday's BOCC Special Meeting, where commissioners are holding a continued public hearing on adopting the 2024 International Codes and Colorado's new low-energy and carbon building standards — rules that will directly shape what gets built in this county for years to come. Alongside that, the Gondola Leadership Committee takes up a real fork-in-the-road decision on whether to pursue federally funded or locally led project delivery. Town P&Z also holds work sessions on a School District employee housing proposal and other ongoing matters.

notable.stake: Public hearing on new county building and energy codes — shapes all future construction.
Vote on federal vs. local financing for gondola project — consequential for local control.
Subcommittee selects Gondola Plaza winter vendors and appoints new chairperson.
Early review of School District employee housing proposal at West Colorado site.
Town housing committee reviews tenant survey, vacancies, and deed-restricted unit policies.
